SILT#00035: Phagocytose, noun, from the Greek roots "phago" meaning "to eat" and "cyto" meaning "cell" (to eat cell). It's the process where cells eat bacteria, debris, nutrients or other particles. Can also be used as a metaphor for when something is subsumed, incorporated, or brought into something else
